query: The 2017–18 Wigan Athletic F.C. season will be a year in which the team competes in the league cup known as what for sponsorship reasons?

repl_history.response:
```repl
import re

sponsor = llm_query(f"From this text, extract the name of the sponsor for the league cup:\n\n{context}")
sponsor_name = re.search(r'(?<=, known as [^\.]*\.)', sponsor).group()
answer = llm_query(f"Given that information, what is the name of the league cup during 2017-18?\n\n{sponsor_name}{context}")
print(answer)
```
